transcript: you unlocked your phone, but what were you going to check? Sometimes, there wasn't a plan. Researchers call brief, repeated looks at your phone a checking habit. A quiet moment can become the cue. A quick look brings new information, and that can reinforce another check. So this isn't always a willpower contest. Try changing the setup. For your next work block, put the phone out of sight and out of reach, not a cure, just one less easy invitation. Give the next check a reason, instead of letting the pause decide.
